info.title: Memoria Familiei API
info.description: MVP contract proposal. Server /api/v1. Cookie SPA and revocable mobile bearer tokens. Cookie mutations require CSRF. Lists are authorization-filtered; cursors use authenticated encryption and are scoped to actor/family/filters. Changes use strong ETags and If-Match. Omitted optional patch fields are unchanged; null clears an optional field where allowed. Source Calendar items are read-only; edit the canonical owner.

IfMatch.name: If-Match

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
